'''Rena''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] who was a member of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Day" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> they and six other<ref name="Day" /> [[Padawan]]s<ref name="Day AD">{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> attended a [[lightsaber combat]] class<ref name="Day" /> on a [[Jedi training|training]] verandah<ref name="AcolyteVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="Day" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]]. Rena and the other students followed a routine using [[bokken saber]]s as the class's [[instructor]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Lakshay]], moved among them giving advice. A chime sounded just as the routine drew to a close and Lakshay announced the session was over.<ref name="Day" /> 

Rena bowed to Lakshay alongside the other students and the Master bowed back before asking Rena and fellow Padawan [[Daro (Jedi)|Daro]] to show<ref name="Day" /> him<ref name="Day AD" /> their opening stance before they left. During the class, Rena wore a set of [[Color|white]] and gold [[Jedi apparel|Jedi]] [[temple robes]] with a brown [[belt]] and brown [[boot]]s. The Padawan's belt was trimmed with a green [[Padawan sash|sash]]<ref name="Day" /> that was the same color as their [[lightsaber]].<ref name="Collection">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: The Lightsaber Collection]]'' — Based on corresponding data for ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' [[Padawan]]s</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Rena appeared in "[[Day (episode)|Day]],"<ref name="Day" /> the fourth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 18]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> It is unclear which of the six human Padawans pictured in the class is intended to be Rena.<ref name="Day" /> The scenes in the Jedi Temple were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, Rena was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]<ref name="Celebration">{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}}</ref> during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].<ref name="CelebrationDate">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}}</ref>
